alignments.note: The particle carries the whole optative frame; the supplied subject and complementizer are helpers under rules 7 and 40.
Substantival article before a participle keeps only the pronoun (rule 32).
The participle carries the supplied relativizer (rules 31-32); head on the lexical verb.

The ASV renders the single verb by the euphemistic phrase 'go beyond circumcision'; the modal is its helper under rule 9. Head on the lexical verb 'go'; a reading heading on 'circumcision' as the meaning-bearing complement under rule 17 remains defensible.
